claim_en: ONE LAW, BY DAY, BY PRIEST; no delay; Munbaz's regress stopped — 'you would add forever'; a leper purifies no leper.
THE KIT SPECS. Equal live pure birds; the cedar billet; good scarlet untried; pure-name hyssop; seven laws off R. Tarfon's staff.
THE COUPLED FATES. The quarter-log visibility ratio; both-ways coupling; slaughtered not pinched; the field-ward release; the returned bird permitted; the dror.
TENT IS HIS WIFE. Bathing gates entry, birds do not; a mikveh suffices; the ban of the counting week; the Jotham datum.
THE THREE SHAVERS. Visible hair by the eyebrow model; razor only, two hairs void it; shave-then-sunset-then-offerings.
THE THUMBS RITE. Two priests, vessel and hand; altar first; the middle ridge; the place causes, not the blood; the missing-thumb dead-end with both arms; the advocate parable.
THE POVERTY SCALE. Both clauses; the asham never scaled; status sampled at the asham; the wife's lien in the contract's own Aramaic.
